notes.title: Colony 37 - Sneak Peak & Upcoming Plans
notes.notes: [h3]Hi everyone![/h3][p][b]Next patch will be slightly delayed (by a day or two)[/b], working on something interesting to implement in to the daily miner's routine. It's a bit of a sneak peak.[/p][p][/p][h3]Clutter and Foliage[/h3][p]Currently game has somewhat of an acceptable code to generate underground ores and it was used literally for every object that is not well... basic dirt. While it serves a good purpose as a "controllable way to generate ores" it quickly started to be not acceptable once you'll try to generate something that is not supposed to be in the wall [i](seriously, who placed land mines right inside of a rock formation)[/i]. Besides that - whole cave systems, albeit simplistic in their nature, became slightly bland because of it. So I'm currently working on fixing that. By the time writing this, I've already implemented the clutter system, now I just need to beautify it for each biome.[/p][p][/p][p]In the screenshots below you can see a direct comparison (Of course amount of clutter is cranked to the maximum for preview purposes):[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Example 1: Clutter Off[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45704128/65f71057686ab9f1bf2d7feb2aacb79d1926ebaa.jpg"][/img][/p][h3][b]Example 1: Clutter On[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45704128/0e68da7345c26f6ec52737b1e4b783f031bf0cd2.jpg"][/img][/p][h3][b]Example 2: Clutter Off[/b][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45704128/deba20de52aeaca3b416a4c7ab3ccf0175c7cc1e.jpg"][/img][/h3][h3][b]Example 2: Clutter On[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45704128/38bcb6b3d06231b3746ffd0a93fdf244befae335.jpg"][/img][/p][h3]What will it mean[/h3][list][*][p]Better and more complex visuals.[/p][/*][*][p]Cave systems that are worth exploring.[/p][/*][*][p]Generation of "forgotten backpacks" containing valuable loot.[/p][/*][*][p]Proper generation of land mines and other threats (They will no longer be inside of the walls).[/p][/*][*][p]More distinct content for each biome.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Additional upcoming things[/h3][p]Apart from bug fixes, next update will also have:[/p][list][*][p][b]Ability to reset your world through PC in the save room (Items and earned credits will remain).[/b][/p][p][i]Considering that I will be messing with a generation for quite a bit - this feature is an absolute must. My main goal is to not reset the player's progress as much as possible, so technically you can avoid pressing this button and the world should work just fine (or almost fine), but it will be highly recommended to do that in order to see the changes.[/i][/p][/*][*][p][b]Minor increase in length for each biome (Total depth will be 350 instead of 300).[/b][/p][p][i]While it's an odd thing to do, it is necessary since each biome will contain slightly more content and features.[/i][/p][/*][*][p][b]Reworked item progression.[/b][/p][p][i]While it seems somewhat reasonable that new items are unlocked through "Total amount of collected credits", it kind of caused an issue where a lot of items are visible and obtainable way sooner (Which is kinda... meh). New system will use "Lowest depth" as the main anchor. It should work slightly better.[/i][/p][/*][*][p][b]Increased prices in the shop.[/b][/p][p][i]Prices will be higher, but I'm planning to add a lot more items and features that will make the collection of credits easier. Both things should even each other out.[/i][/p][/*][*][p][b]Other additions that will be revealed in the update.[/b][/p][/*][/list][p]That is pretty much it, stay tuned, I'll try to get this update as quickly as possible (And not break anything in the process). [/p]

notes.title: Colony 37 0.27 - Small fixes and additions
notes.notes:
[p]This is a small change log aimed to fix couple of issues and add small quality of life improvements.[/p][p]
- [b]Reworked shop and loadout filter. More filter options are available.[/b][/p][p][i]This should hopefully cleanup the UI and make it easier to find the desired item.[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45704128/8f33888c65e4087c00b5e81ea2101765375a515d.png"][/img][/p][p]- [b]Added 4 extra inventory slots for a Light Source, Radiation Counter, Energy Counter, Helmet.[/b][/p][p][i]My first idea was to make "A classic simplified RPG inventory system" where player has 6 slots and he can choose any item he wants, but this idea quickly stopped working when player got hit with a realization that amount of slots is extremely strict to have an enjoyable build creation (one slot is always occupied with light source, Geiger counter and energy counter are just a waste of a slot, since it's more useful to have something that actually boosts your stats). Hopefully these 4 specialized slots will slightly ease up the inventory management and experience in general.[/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45704128/32f4c4426d0037c217a0ed5b2c93265661287536.png"][/img][/p][p]- Energy counter bonus energy decreased from 75 to [b]25[/b].[/p][p]- "Oxys" radiation gain decreased from 0.03 to [b]0.01[/b].[/p][p]- "Boot Modificators T-2" additionally provides with [b]10[/b] maximum health.[/p][p]- "Experimental jumping module" downside removed, now additionally increases movement speed by [b]0.5[/b].[/p][p]- Player now respawns with [b]energy[/b] set to [b]0[/b].[/p][p]- Consumables are now filtered by cost.[/p][p]- Reworked the "Restoration" and "Charge" cost of the nurse from flat 20% of your current cash to value dependent on your missing percentage multiplied by the lowest depth (Now prices should be a lot more reasonable). [b]This restoration can put you in debt[/b].[/p][p]- [b]F5[/b] now makes a quick save (Hopefully it'll save the progress in case something will break).[/p][p]- Increased hub oxygen restoration speed from 5 to [b]15[/b] per second.[/p][p]- Increased hub radiation removal speed from -1 to [b]-5[/b] per second.[/p][p]- Slightly increased the hit box of elevators (Now they should be slightly easier to demolish).[/p][p]- Fixed "Not enough elevator space" issue. Now elevator properly checks for the highest point each time the button is pressed (Except when it's moving).[/p][p]- Fixed an issue that caused modernized drill to be unequippable.[/p][p]- Fixed an issue where person can take damage while being dead.[/p][p]- Fixed an issue where the charges of consumable weren't properly updated.[/p][p]- Fixed an issue where sometimes grass was indestructible.[/p][p]- Fixed hub oxygen restoration boundaries (Now no longer works by being close to the wall).[/p][p]- Fixed lighter and lamp sound effects not being affected by SFX slider.[/p][p]Additional minor bug fixes and changes.[/p]

notes.title: Quick hotfix 0.26
notes.notes:
- Fixed a serious issue that caused player movement to be completely blocked after interacting with a main locker (sorry guys for that, should've found this bug sooner).
- Fixed an issue that caused resources to fly around the player.
- Each backpack gives a bit more slots across the board (Starting from tier-2).
- "Ergon" energy increase per block decreased from 2.5 to [b]1.5[/b].
- "Charged" perk energy regen increased from 0.2 to [b]0.5[/b] per second.
- Increased the speed of dialogues by two times.
- Decreased the volume of dialogues by approximately 20% (I'll change the sound effect).
- Player now starts with Geiger counter at the start of the game (To, hopefully, avoid unneeded deaths by radiation. I'll look in to early game radiation a bit more).

notes.title: Small fixes & balance changes
notes.notes:
[p]- Player maximum health increased from 25 to [b]30[/b].
- Player radiation absorption increased from 0.2 to [b]0.25[/b].
- Fixed a rare issue where shovels would sometimes not deal damage.
- Game is now saved every time player exits to main menu (Collected ores are not saved to avoid unneeded behaviour).

[i]I'm currently looking towards adding custom key bindings, hopefully this should address the issue with Steam Deck.[/i][/p]

notes.title: Colony 37 - Early Access is now LIVE
notes.notes: [p][b]Hi everyone![/b][/p][p]I'm here to inform that [b]Early Access for the Colony 37 is now live and available on Steam![/b][/p][p]I tried to keep pricing of the game as low as possible, so the game costs [b]2.99$[/b] with a [b]10% discount[/b] at release (Lower values would've been a bit too cheap).[/p][p]Additionally, I would like to do a quick Q&A to answer some of the important questions.[/p][p][/p][h3]Is the game finished?[/h3][p]No, far from it in all honesty. My main goal is to create a truly rich and deep (pun intended) mining game with different biomes, secrets and places to discover. While I've already wrote important base mechanics with a good bit of features - there is still so much that I would like to bring to the table.[/p][p][/p][h3]How long does it take to complete this version of the game?[/h3][p]Since the game's world map is completely procedurally generated the time can vary from person to person, although my approximate completion time is somewhere around 4 hours (At least this time took me to reach to the lowest possible depth).[/p][p][/p][h3]How much content can the game provide?[/h3][p][b]38 Instruments[/b]. Some of them are for mining purposes, some of them will help you in finding valuable stuff and some of them you can even place in the world to help you out in your mining expedition (Jump pads, portable extractors, e.t.c).[/p][p][b]50+ Equippable trinkets[/b]. Majority of them will boost your stats (Oxygen, Health, Radiation absorption and stuff like that), although some of them will provide you with some interesting benefits, like increasing your resource drops, giving you a huge boost in strength for a limited time, or restore your consumable charges.[/p][p][b]17 Consumables[/b]. They are mostly used as a solution for any problem... for money. Some of them will restore your oxygen, some of them will heal you e.t.c[/p][p][b]6 Biomes. [/b]I tried to make them as different as possible, although I'll be working on improving them in the future.[/p][p][b]300 meters of mining[/b]. At the lowest point I've placed a blocker that would stop you from mining deeper, although I'll remove it once more biomes will be added.[/p][p][/p][h3]Will there be any bugs?[/h3][p]Yes. Even though I've checked everything dozens of times, as a single developer of this game, I am sure people will find different ways to break the game. But, please tell me about any bug that you would find, I'll try to fix them asap.[/p][p][/p][h3]What are the future plans?[/h3][p]First and foremost - collect as much information from players as possible, fix the balancing where it is needed and add things that people would like to be added (If it'll fit in to the game's world of course).[/p][p]After that - main focus will be to polish the world generation and add more distinct features to each and every biome (Random structures, foliage, improved cave systems). Additionally add more content along the way.[/p][p]I'll add some sort of a road map a bit later.[/p][p][/p][h3]Is it a horror game?[/h3][p]A bit. Even though there are no jump scares, the game has a blend of exploration and the feeling of unease. More horror elements will be added, although it is not in my plans to make it a horror game. Main focus is exploration and mining.[/p][p][/p][p]Hopefully that covers the basic questions. Feel free to ask more of them - I'll do my best to answer as quickly as I can.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Good luck miners![/b][/p]

notes.title: Game Progress / Early Access release reschedule
notes.notes: [h3]Hi everyone! Valen here.[/h3][p]I'm making this announcement to tell what are the current plans and goals for the project, what Colony 37 can offer at the early access release, and the most important one, the date when Early Access version will be released.[/p][p][/p][h2]Release Reschedule[/h2][p]Due to the new stuff that I'm currently working on unfortunately I'll have to delay the release of the game for at least two weeks and it will be releasing in the time period of [b]6th of September (06.09.2025)[/b] to [b]15 of September (15.09.2025)[/b] [b](Updated)[/b] It's not ideal, I know, but I'm trying my best working day and night to make this game not just another digging game, but a game that puts exploration and feeling of discovery in the first place. I just need more time to accomplish this so people will experience first launch with my intended plans. So, since I decided to write the reschedule message, I also decided to share some information about the game's current state.[/p][p][/p][h2]What Early Access launch will have?[/h2][p]I've been working on a lot of new things lately to spice things up as well as polishing the existing mechanics (balancing the game, cost of items and overall game feel). Apart from the basics (Oxygen consumption, radiation eating away your health if you gathered a lot of it, fall damage that... well... hurts) Colony 37 already has features that you can see down below.[/p][p][/p][h3]Biomes[/h3][p]I decided to scrap the idea of having just a mundane depth progression where the only thing that changes in the process is the cost of resources you gain and decided to implement a "Biome" feature. Each biome has it's own set of blocks and minerals to mine as well as crates that contain biome-specific loot. Currently biomes are different in visual style, generation and resources, all though I will add individual biome-specific threats in the future.[/p][p][/p][carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45704128/642c0dd46b7e406d548db17ef36c5e0670b5f19e.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45704128/9add17ffeec3c785657c2e528057ecd24232d4fb.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45704128/d5f7b487f3cc134df5cfd2a61424c5e4afcdfc96.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45704128/8476c0a7d96fbbd9ff6324d94c247de43c405215.jpg"][/img][/carousel][h3]Dialogues[/h3][p]Even though, I'll be completely honest, it's not my main goal to create a vast amount of story telling dialogues (at the current state of game development), there are a couple of people that have a thing or two to say as well as reward you for your progression.[/p][p][/p][carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45704128/526649734e3c01ce7e714d17589437adc2b34747.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45704128/563c4b8f43135a330b5cb7132f2ab0b949cd6a76.jpg"][/img][/carousel][p][/p][h3]Trinkets and Instruments[/h3][p]I've added a lot of trinkets and a couple of instruments that players can buy for credits (or find it in caves). Majority of them provide both positive and negative buffs, so plan accordingly what you equip and what other items might counteract the negative effects.[/p][p][/p][carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45704128/f8f8a9c2d0042e0e8bfb823d3e477ab29d25d46b.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45704128/692d05cfc4b327ad70cc6e0f71ae4bf3088c5136.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45704128/5ab0fc3d3d13356b2277a177554f6913b5c1702c.jpg"][/img][/carousel][p][/p][h3]Placeables[/h3][p]Some of the instruments will provide you with an ability to place them in caves, some of them grant you an ability to jump really high (so you can go back to base easier), provide oxygen, or negate fall damage.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45704128/6e90d2011bb5330b2f63ef25350939fb7f6d4f04.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45704128/fab3c8079deda7f488862e0d04828af19834e934.jpg"][/img][/carousel][p][/p][h3]Laboratories[/h3][p]Honestly this is the number one thing that delays the project release. A game will have a couple (3 at the time of the release of early access) laboratories for story progression. All of the laboratories are generated randomly every time player opens them. They have loot, some of them have huge amounts of radiation, some of them... contain something worse.[/p][p][/p][carousel autoadvance="true"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45704128/8f6cdde26d209873f6bc9e25a980596bacd0c5e0.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45704128/847e90121beb3d41f8e87b6bf688e69c27db9a84.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45704128/70eab3af27b927d3cd8b8bb587c016e24095a3df.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45704128/614449e3dc8334cd39afc7c989274cefaaab6f72.jpg"][/img][/carousel][p][/p][p]There are a couple more things I can show you, but at this state I'd rather save them until they are finished. Really [b]huge thanks[/b] to everyone who wishlisted the game on Steam, sorry again about the delay of release, I'm a single developer of this project and sometimes it's really hard to calculate how much time do I need to finish one thing or the other. I'll continue working hard to provide you with just the right experience I possibly can! Just need a bit more time :)[/p]
